cohort: 14 cases of antenatally diagnosed vasa previa out of 51,500 deliveries at a single hospital between 2014 and 2021
finding: An individualized management protocol for antenatally diagnosed vasa previa, including outpatient management for low-risk patients and scheduled cesarean section around 36 weeks for others, led to favorable maternal and neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Scheduled cesarean section around 36 weeks was performed in 8 patients, and only 3 neonates required NICU admission for transient tachypnea of newborn.
